description: Paid $0.05 per call: the latest official BMKG earthquakes — magnitude, depth, coordinates, region, tsunami potential, felt reports and the official shakemap URL. Up to 15 recent events. With alert=true it returns a decision instead of a feed: alert true/false for minMagnitude (default 5 SR) among the events checked, the matching events and a 180s poll hint — the shape a risk or logistics poller acts on, same upstream call, no extra charge.

alert.description: true = decision view: alert true/false for the threshold below, plus the matching events.

minMagnitude.description: Alert threshold in SR (BMKG Magnitudo). Default 5.
